A PAGE FROM THE FIELD GUIDE

A balanced little world.

Each day, light and your soil determine how much moisture evaporates. Plants use a little water too. There is no random success or failure.

  • Sandy soil loses water fastest; humus-rich soil holds it longest.
  • Each plant has its own preferred moisture and light ranges. Repeated stress gradually reduces health; good conditions help it recover.
  • Springtails and woodlice recycle fallen material in this experience. Their condition depends on moisture; they do not change the water equation.
  • Playback advances one day every 3 seconds. Opening earlier steps or this guide pauses time.
  • Editing earlier steps keeps your plants and day count. Replacing a plant gives that individual a fresh start.

This is a simplified ecological simulation, not a real-world care guide.
